tasks.design: The engineer conducts or directs system-level automotive testing. Nothing is written to {DATA_PLATFORM} in this task. The test and the direction stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer runs the test on the vehicle and directs anyone helping.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored row shortens the test.
tasks.still_hard: Running the test and judging what it shows stay with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer stops a test when the vehicle does not match the plan.
tasks.altitude: System-level testing stays on the vehicle. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Operate the rig under the engineer's direction
reach.learn: Which steps the technician must not change.

evidence.claim: Conducting or directing system-level automotive testing stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a vehicle and a test plan and ends when the test is run or the engineer stops.
No new record is required for the test itself. Upkeep is zero.
A later report of the result, if one is written, is a different task.
unknowns: Which tests the engineer must run in person.
research_questions: How often did the engineer stop a test because the vehicle did not match the plan?

already_counted.description: Conducting system-level automotive testing is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the test adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every test is still run on the vehicle. High: the same test remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct other engineers and support personnel

steps.what: Provide technical direction to other engineers

tasks.design: The engineer provides technical direction to other engineers or engineering support personnel. Nothing is sent by {EMAIL}. The direction stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer answers the question and directs the support work.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored note replaces the direction.
tasks.still_hard: Judging the technical point stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not give a direction the question does not support.
tasks.altitude: Technical direction stays a conversation. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.learn: Which points that engineer will decide alone.

evidence.claim: Giving technical direction to engineers or support personnel stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a technical question and ends when the engineer has directed the people, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Support personnel are directed in the same work. They are not scored.
unknowns: Which decisions the engineer keeps and which another engineer may take.
research_questions: How often did the direction stay a conversation with nothing written?

already_counted.description: Providing technical direction to other engineers is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the direction adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every direction is still given by the engineer. High: the same conversations remain, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open stored failure and variation records

tasks.design: The engineer performs failure, variation, or root cause analyses. {DATA_PLATFORM} only opens the stored failure and variation record. A missing record stays blank. The analyses stay at full effort. No model names the cause.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer pulled the test sheet and worked out the cause.
tasks.enabler_now: A test identifier can open a record the engineer already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Naming the cause stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not treat a blank record as a cause.
tasks.altitude: The analysis stays the engineer's. The screen only opens the stored record.

reach.task: Repeat a measurement the engineer asks for

evidence.claim: A stored test identifier can open a failure record. The cause analysis stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a failure or a variation and ends when the engineer has named a cause or stopped.
A failure row has test identifier, symptom, and part identifier, entered by the engineer from the test. A missing symptom is left blank.
Opening the record does not shorten the analysis. The record does not name the cause.
unknowns: Which failures must be escalated before a cause is closed.
research_questions: How often was the failure record blank, so the engineer went back to the test sheet?

already_counted.description: Performing the cause analyses is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: Correct a part identifier on a failure record the engineer has rechecked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: records are often blank, so the analysis is unchanged. High: the record opens, and the engineer still performs the analyses. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calibrate vehicle control and software systems

steps.what: Calibrate vehicle systems, including control algorithms
Calibrate other software systems on the vehicle

tasks.design: The engineer calibrates vehicle systems, including control algorithms or other software systems. Nothing is written to {OPS_SYSTEM}. Calibration stays at full effort. The engineer signs the result.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer calibrates on the vehicle.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored value sets the calibration.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the calibration stays with the engineer, on the vehicle.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer rejects a calibration that misses the target they were given.
tasks.altitude: Calibration stays on the vehicle. The engineer remains responsible for the signed result.

reach.task: Set the target the calibration must meet

evidence.claim: Calibrating vehicle control algorithms and other software stays manual.
The engineer who signs a safety-related vehicle calibration remains responsible for it.

assumptions: The work starts with a vehicle and a target and ends when the engineer has calibrated or stopped.
No calibration value is invented by a system. Upkeep is zero.
A later write of the signed value, if one is kept, is a different task.
unknowns: Which calibrations are safety-related and must be signed.
research_questions: How often did the engineer reject a first calibration against the target?

already_counted.description: Calibrating vehicle systems and control algorithms is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the calibration adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every calibration is still done on the vehicle. High: the same calibration remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer still tests, calibrates, and signs the design. A report, estimate, procedure, or document is written or published only after the engineer accepts that version.
reach: A project lead receives only a status report the engineer has accepted.
A production colleague receives only a procedure the engineer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required figure, milestone, or price is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep testing, calibration, and design decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every status report traces to a stored milestone, and the engineer still signs the exception.
